Reporting · for sign-off

The red row asks for its note on the box itself; nothing else is locked

Today

Mobile market share is entered at 18% against 32% due. A red bar takes over the top of the page and every other box greys out and refuses typing until the note is written.

Proposed
  • No red bar and nothing greys out. Every figure box stays open, so the person keeps entering numbers.
  • The red row's note box carries a clear tag: Note needed · off track. The box keeps its red edge and asks "Why, and what is being done".
  • The usual "to finish" bar comes back and counts the note among what is left; Next and the Key Objectives chip take you to it.
  • Submit still waits for the note, as it always has. Only the lock goes.

Where the tag sits — three ways

A · above the box — recommended

A red label over the box — reads before the box, never covers what is typed

B · a pill on the box's corner

A solid red pill on the corner — loudest; sits over the box's edge

C · the words inside the box

The tag inside the box — one shape; the box grows a line taller

Everywhere it applies

  • Every Reporting page: units, functions, capabilities and the company, and My reporting — the same tag on the same box.
  • A page that opens with red figures already missing notes shows the tag on each of them; nothing is locked.
  • Tab and Enter move through the boxes as they did before the lock. The note box of a red row is on that path.
